name: Yamaha TT-R250 (1993–2006, 249cc air-cooled DOHC, carb)
source: Yamaha TT-R250 owner's manual periodic maintenance chart (road/trail use), converted from km. Off-road use roughly halves these intervals.

items.name: Interim oil change
items.notes: Yamaha interval for this engine is much shorter than your 5k rule. Oil every ~3,000 km, filter every second change.

items.name: Service inspection (brakes, tyres/spokes, wheel & swingarm bearings, cables, lights)
Drive chain clean, lube & adjust
items.notes: Also every ride off-road. Replace chain and sprockets as a set.

items.name: Air filter (foam): clean & re-oil
items.notes: After every dusty or muddy ride.

items.name: Carburettor: idle, sync & clean
items.notes: Drain the float bowl if it's laid up.

items.name: Steering head & suspension linkage bearings: grease
